title: House of Hundreds – II: Adding and Subtracting 3-Digit Numbers
seo_title: Adding and Subtracting 3-Digit Numbers Class 3 Worksheet with Answers (Maths Mela Chapter 9)
standard_code: Class 3, Maths Mela Chapter 9: House of Hundreds – II
standard_text: Addition and subtraction of numbers up to 1,000 with and without regrouping, and solving problems (summary of NCERT Maths Mela Class 3)
meta_desc: Class 3 House of Hundreds – II worksheet (Maths Mela Chapter 9): column addition and subtraction with regrouping, checking and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Line up ones, tens and hundreds.
key_sub: Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, 10 tens as 1 hundred.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers in columns: hundreds, tens, ones.
  • Add ones first; carry 1 ten if needed.
  • To subtract, break a ten or hundred when the top digit is smaller.

Examples

Example

358 + 276

8 + 6 = 14: write 4, carry 1

5 + 7 + 1 = 13: write 3, carry 1

3 + 2 + 1 = 6

Answer: 634

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the carried 1Write it above the next column.
Taking the smaller digit from the biggerBorrow from the next place.
